agents.result:
I now have a comprehensive picture of the entire CSS codebase. Let me compile the structured report.

---

### SUMMARY

I reviewed all 12 CSS files (≈20,000 lines total), 3 theme files, and `index.html` for the StationOS frontend. The codebase has two parallel CSS variable systems (`--admin-*` theme variables and a legacy `--bg`/`--text` system in main.css), well-structured theme switching with dark/light/blue variants, but suffers from significant hardcoded color values in page-specific CSS, multiple undefined CSS variables, inconsistent typography stacks across pages, and moderate `!important` abuse in the app.css router pages. The overall architecture is functional but would benefit from consolidation of the two variable systems and enforcement of theme-variable usage in page-specific stylesheets.

**CSS Quality Rating: 6/10**

---

### EVIDENCE

- `frontend/index.html:13-14` — CSP is permissive (`* data: blob:`), no `style-src` restriction; no nonce/hash approach for inline styles
- `frontend/index.html:21-22` — Google Fonts loaded via `<link>` with `preconnect` (good), but `font-display` not specified in URL params
- `frontend/index.html:27-37` — Inline `<script>` sets theme on `<html>` but also injects inline `<style>` with `!important` for loader background
- `frontend/index.html:52` — Only `main.css` loaded; all other CSS is imported via `@import` chains, which can cause render-blocking cascades
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:1-3` — Imports `lang-switcher.css`, `rtl-overrides.css`, `panels.css` via `@import`
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:13-65` — `:root` defines non-prefixed variables (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--text`, etc.); dark theme defaults
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:79-111` — Semantic color variables defined (severity, threat, DEFCON, status) — good organizational practice
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:117-192` — `[data-theme="light"]` overrides both theme colors AND semantic colors with darker variants for contrast
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:383,452,4417` — Uses `var(--muted)` which is **never defined** in any stylesheet
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:561,2735-2741` — Uses `var(--primary)` which is **never defined**
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:887` — Uses `var(--green-dim)` which is **never defined**
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:1167` — Uses `var(--accent-red)` which is **never defined**
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:591,10275,10289,10338` — Uses `var(--text-primary)` which is **never defined**
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:233-240` — Global `*, *::before, *::after` transition rule on `background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow` — impacts rendering performance on large DOMs
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:775-784` — Leaflet popups use `!important` for background/color overrides (justified, third-party library)
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:923-940` — Panel span classes use `!important` on `grid-row` and `min-height` — necessary for JS-driven resize but fragile
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:1667,4853,7886,8120,11365,14045,14082,14093,14273` — 9 responsive breakpoints at 480/600/768/1200/2000px + print; no mobile-first approach
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:1` — Imports `theme.css` which chains to three theme files
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:180,230,1424,1493,1555,1781,2246,3495,3522,3765,3807,3866,3883,3902,3936` — 15 instances of hardcoded `color: #fff` instead of `var(--admin-text-on-accent)` or similar
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:302-303` — `!important` on nav-item logout hover background and color
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:2397,2414,2421-2422,2435,2450-2454` — Heavy `!important` usage in realtime-monitor-v2 page overrides (7+ properties per selector)
- `frontend/src/styles/components.css:10,55,81,129,141,157,211,263,315,321,378,396` — All 12 `border-radius` declarations are `0px` — intentionally flat/industrial but inconsistent with pages using rounded corners
- `frontend/src/styles/components.css:7-9,87,91,95,99,103,107` — `var()` fallbacks are identical to primary values (e.g., `var(--admin-border, var(--admin-border))`) — fallbacks provide no actual degradation
- `frontend/src/styles/themes/dark.css:5` — Dark theme selector is `:root, .theme-dark` — `:root` sets the default, which is correct
- `frontend/src/styles/themes/light.css:5` — Light theme selector is `.theme-light` only (no `:root`)
- `frontend/src/styles/themes/blue.css:5` — Blue theme selector is `.theme-blue` only
- All three theme files (`dark.css`, `light.css`, `blue.css`) — 100% consistent `--admin-*` variable set with identical key names; only values differ
- `frontend/src/styles/settings-window.css:1-14` — Creates `--settings-*` aliases from `--admin-*`; good indirection
- `frontend/src/styles/settings-window.css:19` — Uses `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif` instead of `var(--admin-font)` or `var(--font-body)` — inconsistent font stack
- `frontend/src/pages/license/LicensePage.css:29,93,121,136,214` — 5 instances of hardcoded `color: #fff` / `color: white` not using theme variables
- `frontend/src/pages/license/LicensePage.css:86,159` — Hardcoded `color: #44ff88` and `#f87171` instead of `--admin-success`/`--admin-danger`
- `frontend/src/pages/audit-log/AuditLogPage.css:17` — Hardcoded `color: #fff` on `.toolbar-left h2`
- `frontend/src/pages/audit-log/AuditLogPage.css:49-55` — Tag colors hardcoded with `rgba()` and hex values, not using `--admin-tag-*` variables
- `frontend/src/pages/audit-log/AuditLogPage.css:77` — Secondary `.hidden` definition (already in main.css:6-8)
- `frontend/src/pages/alerts-history/AlertsHistoryPage.css:48,129,200,239` — Uses `'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace` instead of `--admin-font-mono`
- `frontend/src/pages/realtime-monitor/RealtimeMonitorPage.css:40,88,139` — Uses `'Courier New', monospace` and `monospace` instead of themed mono font
- `frontend/src/pages/realtime-monitor/RealtimeMonitorPage.css:91,165` — Hardcoded `color: #fff` and `rgba(255,255,255,...)` instead of variables
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:750-762` — `.marker-label-v3` hardcodes `background: #0ea5e9` and `color: #fff`
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:279-280` — `.sidebar-logo` hardcodes `background: #fff` — breaks in light theme (white on white)
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:1887-1907` — Duplicate tag definitions (`.tag-danger`, `.tag-role-admin`) also exist in `components.css:87-108`
- `frontend/src/styles/main.css:207,209` — Body font-size is 13px with 1.5 line-height, but settings-window uses 14px, and various pages use 10-12px for dense data

---

### CHANGES

None.

---

### RISKS

- **Undefined CSS custom properties silently fail**: `--muted`, `--primary`, `--accent-red`, `--green-dim`, `--text-primary` are used in main.css but never defined in any `:root` or theme file. Browsers resolve these to `inherit`/`initial`, causing unpredictable rendering (e.g., `color: var(--muted)` falls back to inherited color, not the intended muted tone). Mitigation: define these variables or replace references with existing defined variables.
- **Hardcoded `#fff`/white colors break light theme**: 30+ instances across page CSS files use `color: #fff` or `color: white` instead of theme-aware variables. In the light theme, white text on light backgrounds becomes invisible. Most critically in `license/LicensePage.css`, `audit-log/AuditLogPage.css`, and `alerts-history/AlertsHistoryPage.css`. Mitigation: replace all hardcoded white text with `var(--admin-text)` or `var(--admin-text-on-accent)` depending on context.
- **`.sidebar-logo` hardcoded `background: #fff`** (`app.css:279`): In light theme, white logo background on white panel becomes invisible. Mitigation: use `var(--admin-accent)` or a theme-aware background.
- **Two parallel variable systems cause confusion**: `main.css` uses `--bg`, `--text`, `--border` while `app.css`/`components.css`/theme files use `--admin-bg`, `--admin-text`, `--admin-border`. Developers must know which system applies where. Mitigation: consolidate to one system, or document clearly which components use which.
- **Global `*` transition rule** (`main.css:233-240`): Applying transitions to all elements causes GPU compositing overhead on pages with many DOM nodes (e.g., the panels grid). Mitigation: scope to specific interactive elements or use `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.
- **No `prefers-reduced-motion` media query** anywhere in the codebase: animations/transitions may cause issues for users with vestibular disorders. Mitigation: wrap all animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.
- **Inconsistent mono font stack**: 4 different mono font declarations across files (`JetBrains Mono`, `Fira Code`, `Consolas`, `Courier New`, `SF Mono`, `Cascadia Code`). The `--admin-font-mono` variable exists but is not used in page-specific CSS. Mitigation: enforce `var(--admin-font-mono)` usage via lint rule.
- **`@import` chain depth**: `index.html` → `main.css` → (`lang-switcher.css`, `rtl-overrides.css`, `panels.css`); `app.css` → `theme.css` → (`dark.css`, `light.css`, `blue.css`). This creates multiple sequential network requests that block first paint. Mitigation: use a build-time CSS bundler (e.g., lightningcss, postcss-import) or inline theme CSS.

---

### BLOCKERS

None.

agents.result:
I now have enough evidence across all 16 pages and the AppShell layout. Here is the full structured review:

---

### SUMMARY
Reviewed all 16 TSX page files and the AppShell layout component of the StationOS frontend. The project uses a consistent dark industrial aesthetic with CSS custom properties (`--admin-*`) for theming, a shared toolbar pattern (`page-toolbar-row`/`page-title-cell`), and a centralized component library (`btn-industrial`, `data-table`, `admin-card`). However, consistency fractures across the codebase: 4 different page-root CSS classes are in use (`admin-page-container`, `alerts-history-page`, `rtm-page`, `list-page`), inline styles dominate over CSS classes (especially in DashboardPage and AlertDetailPage), and responsive design is minimal (one breakpoint at 1440px). Overall UI rating: **6.5/10**.

---

### EVIDENCE

- `frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx:252` — AppShell uses `admin-container` + `themeClass`, with sidebar `NAV_ITEMS` (lines 30-39) and `ADMIN_NAV` (lines 43-48), collapsible sidebar saved to localStorage (line 137).
- `frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx:212` — Active nav detection uses `window.location.pathname` instead of React Router's `useLocation()` hook, causing potential staleness.
- `frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx:179-277` — Entire page uses absolute positioning on every child (`position: 'absolute', top: 10, left: 10` at line 218, `position: 'absolute', top: 10, right: 10` at line 233, bottom bar at line 260). No responsive fallback.
- `frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx:180` — Container uses `className="dashboard-page new-dash-theme"` instead of the shared `admin-page-container`.
- `frontend/src/pages/device-management/DeviceManagementPage.tsx:89` — Uses `admin-page-container` (consistent). Toolbar at lines 91-122 uses `page-toolbar-row`, `page-title-cell`, `page-toolbar-group`, `page-toolbar-cell` — the canonical pattern.
- `frontend/src/pages/device-management/DeviceManagementPage.tsx:97-108` — Tab switcher uses inline `<button>` elements with hardcoded colors (`'var(--admin-accent)'` etc.) instead of CSS classes; `borderRadius` is absent on the tab bar.
- `frontend/src/pages/realtime-monitor/RealtimeMonitorPage.tsx:620` — Uses `className="rtm-page"` (not `admin-page-container`). Toolbar at line 622 uses `page-toolbar-row` with custom `dash-header` class, but has inconsistent bottom padding: `padding: '4px 12px 12px 12px'`.
- `frontend/src/pages/realtime-monitor/RealtimeMonitorPage.css:1` — `.rtm-page` duplicates `display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100%; background:var(--admin-bg); overflow:hidden;` — identical layout to `admin-page-container` (see `frontend/src/styles/app.css:331-340`).
- `frontend/src/pages/alerts-history/AlertsHistoryPage.tsx:281` — Uses `className="alerts-history-page"` (4th distinct page-root class). Toolbar uses `ah-toolbar-container`/`ah-toolbar-cell` instead of the shared `page-toolbar-row`/`page-toolbar-cell`.
- `frontend/src/pages/alerts-history/AlertsHistoryPage.css:1-10` — `.alerts-history-page` has the same CSS properties as `admin-page-container` but is a separate class, duplicating layout logic.
- `frontend/src/pages/alert-detail/AlertDetailPage.tsx:78-94` — Loading/error states use `className="list-page"` (5th distinct page-root). Uses `window.confirm()` (line 67) and `prompt()` (line 53) instead of the project's `confirmDialog` utility.
- `frontend/src/pages/alert-detail/AlertDetailPage.tsx:162` — `maxWidth: 900, margin: '0 auto'` — centered narrow layout wastes horizontal space on wide monitors.
- `frontend/src/pages/analytics/AnalyticsLayout.tsx:1-19` — Only 18 lines; reuses `alerts-history-page` CSS via import (line 2 of `AnalyticsLayout.css`). No summary KPI cards or sub-navigation.
- `frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:25` — Uses `alerts-history-page` class. Has `padding: 8` as inline style that compounds with the class's own `padding: 8px` — probable double-padding.
- `frontend/src/pages/maintenance/MaintenancePage.tsx:208` — Uses `admin-page-container`. Stat grid at lines 223-240 is well-structured. Expandable rows use `colSpan={8}` (line 383) but the table only has 7 `<th>` columns (lines 311-319).
- `frontend/src/pages/audit-log/AuditLogPage.tsx:119-169` — Custom `renderTableHead()` function with 5 different column layouts depending on tab — good approach but duplicates column definition logic.
- `frontend/src/pages/settings/SettingsPage.tsx:26-57` — Cleanest page: uses `admin-page-container`, `page-toolbar-row`, `page-title-cell`, `btn-industrial` consistently. Delegates content to tab components.
- `frontend/src/pages/rule-engine/RuleEnginePage.tsx:278` — Uses `admin-page-container`. Toggle switches at lines 384-390 use custom inline-styled checkboxes instead of the shared `.toggle-switch` CSS class defined in `frontend/src/styles/components.css:122-148`.
- `frontend/src/pages/user-management/UserManagementPage.tsx:130` — Uses `admin-page-container`. Has two separate `admin-card` sections (line 140 for user table, line 181 for permissions matrix).
- `frontend/src/pages/login/LoginPage.tsx:55` — Login button background hardcoded to `#0284c7` rather than using `var(--admin-accent)` or `var(--admin-btn-primary-bg)`.
- `frontend/src/pages/login/LoginPage.tsx:41` — Artificial 600ms `setTimeout` delay on login ("tránh cảm giác phản hồi quá nhanh") — comment admits this is intentional but it degrades UX.
- `frontend/src/pages/license/LicensePage.tsx:137` — Uses `className="license-page"` with its own CSS, not inside AppShell, not using shared admin styles.
- `frontend/src/pages/multisite/MultisitePage.tsx:80` — Uses `window.L` (Leaflet global) — fragile dependency. Map initialization at line 83 hardcodes Vietnam center `[16.0, 107.5]`.
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:4086-4194` — Single responsive breakpoint at `max-width: 1440px`; no mobile/tablet breakpoints anywhere in the codebase.
- `frontend/src/styles/app.css:355-365` — `.page-content:has(...)` selector strips padding/max-width for special pages; this is a clever CSS-only approach but fragile to class name changes.
- `frontend/src/styles/components.css:158-185` — `btn-industrial` and its variants (`btn-primary`, `btn-danger`, `btn-sm`) are well-defined and used across most admin pages.
- `frontend/src/styles/components.css:7-18` — `admin-card` and `data-table` are well-defined shared components, used in DeviceManagement, Maintenance, UserManagement, RuleEngine, Settings.

---

### CHANGES
None.

---

### RISKS

- **5 incompatible page-root CSS classes**: `admin-page-container`, `alerts-history-page`, `rtm-page`, `list-page`, `license-page` (plus `dashboard-page`). Each duplicates flex-column layout. A single change to the base layout must be replicated 4-5 times. **Mitigation**: consolidate all pages to use `admin-page-container` with optional modifier classes.
- **DashboardPage is entirely absolutely positioned**: `overflow: hidden` + no scroll + fixed pixel positions means the page breaks below ~1280px width. KPI cards and alert panel overlap the SLD canvas on smaller screens. **Mitigation**: use CSS Grid with named areas for the dashboard, or at minimum add a horizontal scroll fallback.
- **No mobile/tablet breakpoints**: The single `@media (max-width: 1440px)` rule only adjusts toolbar sizing. All pages assume a minimum 1280px desktop viewport. **Mitigation**: add breakpoints at 768px and 1024px; collapse sidebar to overlay mode on small screens.
- **Inline styles dominate**: DashboardPage, RealtimeMonitorPage, AlertDetailPage, and large sections of RuleEnginePage use inline `style={{}}` objects extensively (hundreds of lines). This makes theming, maintenance, and design-audit nearly impossible without touching JSX. **Mitigation**: extract repeated inline patterns into CSS classes; at minimum use CSS custom properties for colors that currently hardcode hex values.
- **`colSpan={8}` mismatch in MaintenancePage** (line 383): the expanded-row `<td>` claims 8 columns but the table has only 7 `<th>` headers (lines 311-319). This may cause rendering quirks in some browsers. **Mitigation**: align colSpan to the actual column count (should be 7).
- **Hardcoded hex colors in LoginPage and RealtimeMonitorPage**: `#0284c7` (login button), `#44ff88` (login accent), `#3b82f6`, `#ef4444`, `#fbbf24` (ROI overlays) bypass the `--admin-*` theming system — dark/light theme toggle won't affect these. **Mitigation**: map these to semantic CSS variables or theme-aware classes.
- **`window.L` global for Leaflet**: MultisitePage assumes Leaflet is loaded as a global `<script>` tag, with no error handling if missing. **Mitigation**: import Leaflet as an npm dependency or add a defensive check with a user-facing error message.

---

### BLOCKERS
None.
